apis.example: local cd = C_Spell.GetSpellCooldown(id); if cd and cd.duration > 0 then ... end
apis.name: GetSpellCooldown
apis.notes: SpellCooldownInfo {startTime, duration, isEnabled (boolean), modRate}; old: start, duration, enabled (1/0), modRate
apis.secrecy: returns #1 secret (conditional); when SecretWhenCooldownsRestricted; struct fields secret: SpellCooldownInfo.startTime, SpellCooldownInfo.duration, SpellCooldownInfo.modRate, SpellCooldownInfo.activeCategory, SpellCooldownInfo.timeUntilEndOfStartRecovery

apis.example: local info = C_Spell.GetSpellInfo(id); local name, icon = info and info.name, info and info.iconID
apis.name: GetSpellInfo
apis.notes: SpellInfo {name, iconID, originalIconID, castTime, minRange, maxRange, spellID}; old: name, rank, icon, castTime, minRange, maxRange, spellID, originalIcon. rank is gone. Returns nil for unknown spells.

apis.example: local aura = C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDataByIndex(unit, i, filter); if not aura then break end
apis.name: UnitAura
apis.notes: AuraData {name, icon, applications, dispelName, duration, expirationTime, sourceUnit, isStealable, spellId, auraInstanceID, isHelpful, isHarmful, ...}; AuraUtil.UnpackAuraData(aura) rebuilds the old tuple. Prefer UNIT_AURA updateInfo + C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDataByAuraInstanceID.
